title: Engineering IDs present
description: Every object requires a non-empty engineering ID.
rationale: Every object requires a non-empty engineering ID.
acceptance_criteria: Every object requires a non-empty engineering ID.

title: Engineering IDs unique
description: Engineering IDs must be globally unique.
rationale: Engineering IDs must be globally unique.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering IDs must be globally unique.

title: Provenance available
description: Every object should retain source provenance.
rationale: Every object should retain source provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Every object should retain source provenance.

title: Version metadata present
description: Every object requires engineering version metadata.
rationale: Every object requires engineering version metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Every object requires engineering version metadata.

title: Recognized BPMN types
description: Unknown BPMN object types are not releaseable.
rationale: Unknown BPMN object types are not releaseable.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown BPMN object types are not releaseable.

title: Flow endpoints resolve
description: Every flow source and target must resolve.
rationale: Every flow source and target must resolve.
acceptance_criteria: Every flow source and target must resolve.

title: No self-loop sequence flows
description: Sequence flows should not connect an element to itself.
rationale: Sequence flows should not connect an element to itself.
acceptance_criteria: Sequence flows should not connect an element to itself.

title: Flow IDs present
description: Every flow requires an engineering ID.
rationale: Every flow requires an engineering ID.
acceptance_criteria: Every flow requires an engineering ID.

title: Sequence flows connect flow nodes
description: Sequence flows must connect BPMN flow nodes.
rationale: Sequence flows must connect BPMN flow nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Sequence flows must connect BPMN flow nodes.

title: No duplicate directed sequence edges
description: Duplicate sequence edges between identical endpoints are prohibited.
rationale: Duplicate sequence edges between identical endpoints are prohibited.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate sequence edges between identical endpoints are prohibited.

title: Start events have no incoming sequence flow
description: Start events must not have incoming sequence flows.
rationale: Start events must not have incoming sequence flows.
acceptance_criteria: Start events must not have incoming sequence flows.

title: Start events have outgoing sequence flow
description: Start events require at least one outgoing flow.
rationale: Start events require at least one outgoing flow.
acceptance_criteria: Start events require at least one outgoing flow.

title: End events have no outgoing sequence flow
description: End events must not have outgoing sequence flows.
rationale: End events must not have outgoing sequence flows.
acceptance_criteria: End events must not have outgoing sequence flows.

title: End events have incoming sequence flow
description: End events require at least one incoming flow.
rationale: End events require at least one incoming flow.
acceptance_criteria: End events require at least one incoming flow.

title: Intermediate events are connected
description: Intermediate events require incoming and outgoing connectivity.
rationale: Intermediate events require incoming and outgoing connectivity.
acceptance_criteria: Intermediate events require incoming and outgoing connectivity.

title: Gateways are connected
description: Gateways require incoming and outgoing sequence flows.
rationale: Gateways require incoming and outgoing sequence flows.
acceptance_criteria: Gateways require incoming and outgoing sequence flows.

title: Diverging exclusive gateways split
description: Diverging exclusive gateways should have at least two outgoing flows.
rationale: Diverging exclusive gateways should have at least two outgoing flows.
acceptance_criteria: Diverging exclusive gateways should have at least two outgoing flows.

title: Converging exclusive gateways merge
description: Converging exclusive gateways should have at least two incoming flows.
rationale: Converging exclusive gateways should have at least two incoming flows.
acceptance_criteria: Converging exclusive gateways should have at least two incoming flows.

title: Parallel gateways are not one-in-one-out
description: Parallel gateways must model an actual split or join.
rationale: Parallel gateways must model an actual split or join.
acceptance_criteria: Parallel gateways must model an actual split or join.

title: Gateway degree bounded
description: Gateways should not exceed twelve incoming or outgoing flows.
rationale: Gateways should not exceed twelve incoming or outgoing flows.
acceptance_criteria: Gateways should not exceed twelve incoming or outgoing flows.

title: Tasks are named
description: Tasks require a human-readable name.
rationale: Tasks require a human-readable name.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks require a human-readable name.

title: Task names are concise
description: Task names should not exceed 120 characters.
rationale: Task names should not exceed 120 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Task names should not exceed 120 characters.

title: Tasks are connected
description: Tasks require incoming or outgoing process connectivity.
rationale: Tasks require incoming or outgoing process connectivity.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks require incoming or outgoing process connectivity.

title: No direct start-to-end trivial process
description: A process should not consist only of a direct start-to-end flow.
rationale: A process should not consist only of a direct start-to-end flow.
acceptance_criteria: A process should not consist only of a direct start-to-end flow.

title: Graph has roots
description: The sequence-flow graph requires at least one root.
rationale: The sequence-flow graph requires at least one root.
acceptance_criteria: The sequence-flow graph requires at least one root.

title: Graph has sinks
description: The sequence-flow graph requires at least one sink.
rationale: The sequence-flow graph requires at least one sink.
acceptance_criteria: The sequence-flow graph requires at least one sink.

title: No unreachable flow nodes
description: All flow nodes should be reachable from a graph root.
rationale: All flow nodes should be reachable from a graph root.
acceptance_criteria: All flow nodes should be reachable from a graph root.

title: Cycles require review
description: Sequence-flow cycles require explicit engineering review.
rationale: Sequence-flow cycles require explicit engineering review.
acceptance_criteria: Sequence-flow cycles require explicit engineering review.

title: Flow nodes have geometry
description: Every flow node should have geometric bounds.
rationale: Every flow node should have geometric bounds.
acceptance_criteria: Every flow node should have geometric bounds.

title: Bounds are positive
description: Node bounds must have positive width and height.
rationale: Node bounds must have positive width and height.
acceptance_criteria: Node bounds must have positive width and height.

title: Flows have geometry
description: Flows should retain path or waypoint geometry.
rationale: Flows should retain path or waypoint geometry.
acceptance_criteria: Flows should retain path or waypoint geometry.

title: Objects are visible
description: Releaseable BPMN objects must be visible.
rationale: Releaseable BPMN objects must be visible.
acceptance_criteria: Releaseable BPMN objects must be visible.

title: Source SHA available
description: Objects should retain source SHA-256 provenance.
rationale: Objects should retain source SHA-256 provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Objects should retain source SHA-256 provenance.

title: No empty repository
description: A release repository must contain BPMN objects.
rationale: A release repository must contain BPMN objects.
acceptance_criteria: A release repository must contain BPMN objects.

title: At least one start event
description: The model should contain at least one start event.
rationale: The model should contain at least one start event.
acceptance_criteria: The model should contain at least one start event.

title: At least one end event
description: The model should contain at least one end event.
rationale: The model should contain at least one end event.
acceptance_criteria: The model should contain at least one end event.
